'''Platform 643''' was a landing platform located on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] when they sent a team including [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] to met [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Issan Len]].
